title: 某团队在bioRxiv发表革兰氏阳性菌对宿主衍生抗菌脂质LPC及pLPC的敏感性差异及适应机制研究
originalTitle: Gram-positive bacteria have different susceptibilities to the host-derived antimicrobial lysophosphatidylcholine and adapt to lysophosphatidylcholine-induced stress via distinct mechanisms
summary: 某团队在bioRxiv发表研究，揭示革兰氏阳性菌对宿主衍生抗菌脂质LPC及pLPC的敏感性差异及适应机制。实验显示S. aureus和S. agalactiae对LPC敏感但E. faecalis不完全抑制，发现E. faecalis通过walK基因突变等机制保护共居菌，并首次观察到自发耐药的S. aureus菌株。
